name: parts-segmenter
architecture: YOLOv8-seg with NMS baked in at export
intendedUse: Identify which car panel a damage region overlaps
Used after damage detection to label the damaged panel
limitations: Includes a generic 'object' class that often wins low-conf predictions
Mask prototypes are exported but not used (we only consume bboxes)
Confidence threshold of 0.10 in original code is permissive
knownIssues: Conf threshold 0.10 too low — flagged as F-11 in audit
No damage-class consistency check (e.g., tire_flat being matched to a hood panel)
